course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Handle a healthcare follow-up by summarizing advice and choosing the next step.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A person receives general advice after a minor health contact and must decide what to do next.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Reporting advice, describing a condition, and deciding whether to wait, call, or rebook.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a follow-up after contact with the vårdcentral, summarize the advice, and decide what condition would require another call.

main_focus.name: reported advice with condition and next step
main_focus.description: Summarize advice from a health contact and link it to a condition for future action.
model_examples: De sa att jag skulle vila och dricka mycket.
Om symtomen blir värre behöver jag ringa igen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2-3 reported-advice sentences and 2 condition-next-step sentences naturally.

allowed_supporting_grammar: modal verbs: skulle, behöver, borde, kan
subordinate clauses with om and när

vocabulary_target.theme: health follow-up and practical next step
useful_chunks: Då vet jag vad nästa steg är.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use health vocabulary responsibly as practical language, not medical instruction.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker reports general advice from a healthcare contact.
dialogue_shape.middle: They clarify what the advice means and what condition would change the plan.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose whether to wait, call again, or rebook and summarize the next step.

target_complexity.repetition: reported advice and conditional next-step language should recur naturally

focus: the condition that would change the next step
the decision about waiting, calling, or rebooking

sentence_focus: one sentence reporting advice with De sa att
one sentence with Rådet var att
one condition sentence with Om det blir värre
one sentence summarizing the next step
